match.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United
match.h2h: Manchester United hold a slight edge in recent meetings with 18 wins to Liverpool's 14 alongside 11 draws, though Liverpool won their most recent Premier League clash 3-2 in May 2026 and have kept seven clean sheets in their last 10 league home games against United.
